name: friskydev-cloudflare
description: FR!SKY Cloudflare tools on the Frisky Dev MCP: deploy built sites to Cloudflare Pages, list Pages projects/deployments and status, list/deploy Workers, read DNS, purge cache. Token stays server-side.
author: FriskyDevelopments
skillInstructions: Use for Cloudflare Pages deploys and status, Workers, DNS reads and cache purges. Call cloudflare_status first. Deploy and purge tools are externally visible: confirm with the user before calling them.

interface.shortDescription: Pages deploys, Workers, DNS and cache via the Frisky Dev MCP
interface.longDescription: Cloudflare tools served by mcp.friskydev.com: cloudflare_pages_deploy (direct upload of a build dir), Pages projects/deployments/status, Workers list/deploy, DNS zones/records (read), cache purge. Auth is a Cloudflare API token set by the owner as a server secret.
